## Screener: Compare Step  (spec §4.1 · §10.2 item 4)
Shared by Capture Call (AI verdict arrived) and Mark + Compare (screener picked). Saves a new verdict FIRST, then reads the contact, pairs Screener Outcome with Screen AI Verdict, and writes stage, tags, block follower, Date Screened, Screen Noise.
Guard: does nothing unless the contact is tagged screening. Waits (writes only the verdict/noise) until both marks exist, unless force=true. ok=false (a failed request, or a retryable state) leaves writeback_ok=false for Screener: Write-back Retry. All logic is in Decide; the rest only executes its ops.
